deployment.responsibility: Package, configure, upgrade, roll back and recover the same governed product across managed, private-cloud and on-prem delivery.
deployment.failure: Readiness fails on required dependencies; rehearse rollback and recovery before promotion. Never report liveness as durability.
deployment.tenancy: Deployment operators manage topology; dedicated environments or namespace separation do not replace application tenant authorization.
deployment.deployment: Compose is a local topology; Helm profiles declare hosting choices. TLS, HA, backup and capacity need deployment-specific evidence.
deployment.contract: Versioned images, chart values/schema, readiness, migration and recovery evidence; no implicit enablement by edition.

trust.responsibility: Identity, tenancy, authorization, policy, append-only audit, evidence lineage and credential authority.
trust.failure: Unknown identity, tenant, scope, policy or lease denies the affected governed operation; preserve evidence on retry.
trust.tenancy: Bind tenant and actor from verified identity; isolate every persisted ID, grant, cache and evidence query. Operator cross-tenant scopes are explicit.
trust.deployment: Shared governance semantics in every edition; hosted defaults cannot replace private-cloud/on-prem identity and key configuration.
trust.contract: Verified principal and scoped permission decisions, current lease/policy references, append-only audit, redacted provenance; never caller-supplied approval booleans.

data.responsibility: Source contracts, raw ingestion, transformations, quality, catalog and source provenance metadata.
data.failure: Stale bindings, absent credentials/egress, incomplete reads and unknown replay history fail closed; payload/metadata divergence is reconciled explicitly.
data.tenancy: Source activation, claims, checkpoints, payload keys and metadata indexes bind tenant/resource/generation. Source rows are not audit payloads.
data.deployment: Object storage holds raw content; Postgres holds governed metadata. External source connectivity remains opt-in and locally operable.
data.contract: Authoring/read/event contracts and governed sink handoff; catalog stores source provenance, while trust owns audit and evidence policy.

operational-model.responsibility: Versioned objects, relationships, business logic and action definitions, including permission requirements on those definitions.
operational-model.failure: Reject unknown object/schema/action versions and stale preconditions; graph mutations require explicit evidence and runtime gates.
operational-model.tenancy: Every object, relationship and action definition carries tenant scope; trust evaluates permission requirements before access or execution.
operational-model.deployment: Postgres persists operational state and reference graph; optional TypeDB query/mutation adapters have separate readiness gates.
operational-model.contract: Versioned ontology query/mutation and action definition models; no direct TypeQL, SQL or store access from a vertical client.

workflow.responsibility: Durable runs, approvals, scheduling, automations, deterministic scenarios and governed writeback orchestration.
workflow.failure: Use caller-owned transaction, idempotency, outbox and claim fencing; ambiguous delivery is reconciled, not silently retried as a new action.
workflow.tenancy: Workflow/approval/run IDs and signal payloads bind tenant; recheck current grants and approval evidence at external side-effect boundaries.
workflow.deployment: Temporal is adopted behind Axis ports. A database decision and a Temporal signal are not one cross-service transaction.
workflow.contract: Versioned run requests, approval-decision signals, status/evidence and deterministic scenario results; adapters own I/O, host owns authorization.

intelligence.responsibility: Permission-aware search, model selection, evaluations, agents and governed assistant capability routing.
intelligence.failure: Refuse missing source/grant evidence; deny unapproved model egress; never turn uncertain model output into authorized writeback.
intelligence.tenancy: Filter retrieval by current tenant/principal before ranking or generation; include identity/policy revision in cache keys and recheck action proposals.
intelligence.deployment: Models may be self-hosted or approved external providers. Search/assistant expansion remains planned and must work through replaceable adapters.
intelligence.contract: Grounded result/evidence envelopes, ModelInvocationRuntime and typed action proposals; no independent workflow, identity or credential authority.

experience.responsibility: Console applications, dashboards, vertical packs, SDKs and future low/pro-code authoring tools.
experience.failure: Render typed unavailable/refusal states, cancel stale principal-bound queries and preserve explicit approval steps.
experience.tenancy: Use authenticated API/SDK contracts only. Pack configuration and UI state never authorize a tenant or reveal another tenant cache.
experience.deployment: The same client contracts serve managed and self-hosted deployments. A published SDK or pack requires its own release process.
experience.contract: Versioned HTTP/OpenAPI and SDK surfaces; packs declare data/model/workflow dependencies and invoke public ports without core importing pack code.

ports.input: Versioned deployment profile and explicit runtime configuration
ports.compatibility: Version images, chart schema and migration chain; rehearse rollback

ports.input: Verified ScopePrincipal, tenant and required scopes
ports.failure: Unknown/mismatched tenant and missing scopes deny governed access; demo exceptions remain explicitly configured
ports.compatibility: Preserve public reason codes and tenant-binding semantics

ports.input: Trusted actor/tenant and redacted domain transition evidence
ports.output: Append-only ledger records and metadata query results
ports.failure: Do not commit a governed domain transition without its required audit record
ports.compatibility: Append schema/versioned evidence; never rewrite history

ports.input: Negotiated 1.0 read requests or opt-in 1.1 event validation with host context
ports.output: Bounded ReadBatch/checkpoint candidate or EventCandidate metadata
ports.failure: Refuse stale source/schema, missing admission and unknown history
ports.compatibility: Explicit major/minor negotiation; publication and host adoption are separate

ports.input: Tenant-scoped catalog/lineage query and source activation metadata
ports.output: Metadata-only assets, quality states and provenance references
ports.failure: Denied reads or incomplete coverage do not become empty success
ports.compatibility: Preserve IDs/cursors/source fingerprints and metadata-only schema

ports.output: Typed graph result/permission metadata or mutation evidence
ports.failure: Reject scope/version/binding errors; optional backend failure does not bypass permission
ports.compatibility: Current reference graph payload retained; sector-neutral extension needs a versioned migration

ports.input: Current schema-validated action definition with parameters and permission requirements; per-definition version fields remain planned
ports.output: Registered action definition or validation errors
ports.failure: Invalid current schema refuses registration; version-aware execution needs a reviewed future contract
ports.compatibility: Strict current schema has no per-definition version field; versioning requires a compatible migration, never implicit acceptance

ports.input: WorkflowSignalRequest and governed run/action idempotency references
ports.failure: Uncertain dispatch stays recoverable through existing outbox ownership
ports.compatibility: Preserve axis.approval-decision.v1 signal shape and IDs

ports.failure: Refuse invalid endpoint/egress, expose fixed safe provider failure
ports.compatibility: Provider adapter replacement preserves typed envelopes and evidence contract

ports.input: Authenticated scoped search query or typed capability request
ports.output: Source-bound results, refusal or action proposal requiring existing workflow approvals
ports.failure: Missing/stale permission or source evidence refuses; no model-granted authority
ports.compatibility: Ship FTS before hybrid/answers; planned ports need independent API/schema review

ports.input: Authenticated versioned HTTP requests via AxisClient/AsyncAxisClient or web transport
ports.output: Validated response DTOs and request-correlated errors
ports.failure: Cancel/invalidate principal changes; render refusal/unavailable explicitly
ports.compatibility: Retain REST aliases under deprecation policy; no direct store/provider access

ports.input: Versioned declarative object/source/workflow/app definitions and declared dependencies
ports.output: Reviewed installation plan and tenant-scoped activated resources
ports.failure: Reject missing dependency/version/evidence; installation cannot grant source/write authority
ports.compatibility: No runtime loader here; pack schemas and lifecycle require separate implementation
